2026-04-28.title: OpenAI-Linked Stocks Slump on Report of Startup Missing Targets
2026-04-28.description: Shares in OpenAI partners such as SoftBank Group Corp. and Oracle Corp. are falling after the Wall Street Journal reported that the AI startup recently failed to meet targets for sales and new users, reviving worries about spending ahead of tech earnings.
